title: A conditional applicability marker licenses a rule only under a stated context

evidence.quote:
This removes the simplest alternative that GDT267 merely compared different
host vocabularies on earlier and later records. The same opaque PAGE_HOST can
occur with q and bare rendering, and q remains earlier-associated within exact
page/host strata.

source_limits: GDT269 conditional means statistical stratification by page/host, not an if/applicability meaning. Its source explicitly assigns no semantic operator. No q→if claim or independent condition labels follow.
The conditional-applicability idea is related to causal, modal and exception designs but is retained as a different raw target, not proven novel by lexical screening.
A conditional rule may remain written when its antecedent is false. Written presence, physical execution and authorization must be distinguished before the proposed falsifier can select a meaning.

Missing independent endpoint data block experimental readiness, not raw retention. The original zero-intake screen conflated eight navigation searches with six grouped candidate records; those counts are not eight assessed scientific ideas.
